links.outcome: AI outreach engagement (FIT opt-in, connect rate, call duration) stratified by patient language
links.effect: Spanish-speaking patients had higher FIT opt-in (18.2% vs 7.1%, P<.001), connect rates (69.6% vs 53.0%), and call duration (6.05 vs 4.03 min) than English-speaking; adjusted OR 2.012 (95% CI 1.340-3.019).
links.quote: Spanish-speaking patients demonstrated significantly higher engagement across all measures than English-speaking patients with respect to FIT test opt-in rates (18.2% vs 7.1%, P<.001), connect rates (69.6% vs 53.0%, P<.001), and call duration (6.05 vs 4.03 minutes, P<.001).

unlisted_practices: language-concordant AI voice outreach for preventive care screening

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world deployment of a multilingual AI conversational agent conducting telephone outreach to patients for colorectal cancer screening, analyzing differences in opt-in and engagement rates between Spanish- and English-speaking patients.
